sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-09 and 2016-12-09, account C07671 on card C07671-K2 was subjected to unauthorized fraudulent activity consistent with account takeover. A total of 5 transaction(s) were flagged, representing an aggregate exposure of $1853.86 USD. Investigation uncovered common infrastructure links to connected card(s) C05031-K2, C05245-K2, C04597-K1, C12942-K2, C11000-K2, C07212-K1, C11309-K1, C02716-K1, C04108-K2, C13171-K2, C05381-K2, C07562-K2, C12028-K2, C09290-K1, C11509-K2, C00854-K2, C02147-K2, C00294-K2, C04125-K1, C06224-K2, C01155-K2, C05560-K2, C08391-K2, C08962-K2, C05704-K2, C12897-K1, C10308-K1, C06744-K2, C00750-K2, C11923-K2. Customer was contacted and reported: 'Customer denied the transaction when asked'. The pattern of unauthorized transactions diverges significantly from cardholder historical profile. Based on regulatory guidelines under FinCEN and bank fraud policy R2/R6, the card has been blocked and reissued, connected entities placed under heightened monitoring, and this report is submitted to document the illicit financial activity.
